note: Editorial descriptions of public repositories, not a security certification or adoption ranking. Read each repository's license.

entries.name: Forge 50
entries.description: 50 skills for planning, building, researching, and shipping with evidence.
entries.start: Choose one skill for the job you have now. The pack's README routes by outcome; you do not need to load all 50.
entries.caution: Read the selected SKILL.md and its referenced instructions. Installation and tool permissions depend on your agent harness.

entries.name: Uncle Bob Skills
entries.description: 50 software-craft skills with executable checks and documented limits.
entries.start: Pick one software-craft concern, read the island's SKILL.md, and follow its documented worked example before combining skills.
entries.caution: Review scripts before running a check. A passing gate establishes only its documented scope, not overall production readiness.

entries.name: Memory Mastery
entries.description: Recall, Genesis, and Hivemind for inspecting and organizing agent memory.
entries.start: Use Recall to inspect an existing memory store, Genesis to plan a new one, or Hivemind to reconcile shared memory.
entries.caution: Back up memory first. Keep private and tenant-specific information separate, inspect proposed writes, and do not treat stored text as trusted instructions.

entries.name: Dogfood Readiness
entries.description: Evaluate whether a product is ready for real use with an evidence-first audit.
entries.start: Choose a specific product and user journey, then use the repository's audit instructions to collect evidence for that scope.
entries.caution: Audit conclusions depend on the journeys and environments actually tested. A report is not permission to deploy or change production.

entries.name: ARCHIPELAGO
entries.description: Coordinate a full build through typed contracts and evidence-gated stages.
entries.start: Read the protocol and stage contracts, define a bounded build, and agree on permissions and review gates before execution.
entries.caution: Multi-agent plans can create files and invoke tools. Review task boundaries, cost limits, and external-action authority before dispatch.

entries.name: Iron Canvas
entries.description: A design methodology with treatment registers and evidence-gated review.
entries.start: Read the current repository's entry guide, select a treatment register for your surface, and approve the brief before building.
entries.caution: Generated designs and review scores are not accessibility or usability evidence. Test the implementation with actual interactions and viewports.

entries.name: YPE Pipeline
entries.description: Turn video and playlist material into timestamped, inspectable knowledge assets.
entries.start: Read the pipeline and licensing terms. Select a small, permitted source batch and agree on the outputs before analysis.
entries.caution: This public repository is not open-source licensed. Obtain permission for uses not granted in writing; respect source-media rights and provider costs.

entries.name: AGIF Spec
entries.description: A draft format for typed intelligence signals, intent profiles, and provenance chains.
entries.start: Read the draft specification and sample signals. Inspect the validator before running its documented self-test on local fixtures.
entries.caution: Schema validity and hash continuity do not establish that a signal is factually true or that its source is trustworthy.

entries.name: NorthStar Bootstrap
entries.description: A portable, progressively loaded entry into the North Star build methodology.
entries.start: Review the noncommercial license and portability guide. Select the convention file for your harness without replacing existing project instructions blindly.
entries.caution: Noncommercial and share-alike terms apply. Generated instruction files guide an agent; they are not OS-level permission enforcement.

entries.name: NorthStar CLI
entries.description: Compile governance settings into tool-native instructions and inspect local build workflows.
entries.start: Read the capability assessment and installation section. Begin with documented preview or dry-run modes in a disposable project.
entries.caution: The engine and bundled methodology have different licenses. Check current package publication status and hook effects before installing globally.

entries.name: Garnet
entries.description: An agent-native systems and scripting language platform in active development.
entries.start: Start at the repository's current release and getting-started documentation; choose a small example that matches a supported toolchain.
entries.caution: This is a language platform, not an installable skill pack. Review its release status, toolchain requirements, and license before adoption.
